plan_phases: TrackWayFastPlan 0.2/0.4 seam design as decision 0005 (not built)
scope: Exact pruned nearest-point projection with a new track invariant, and a standalone steady-state tire force model. No plant, controller or recording behaviour changed.

micro_benchmark.note: Scratch Release benchmark outside the repository, 851-sample preset, 2000 random states within 4 m of the centerline, same host before and after. Measurement only.

validate_track_us.intermediate_rejected: 20.0 when the chord tolerance was computed for every segment

projection_equivalence.comparison: index, fraction, s_m, signed_error_m, distance_m, point.x, point.y compared with == against the previous exhaustive scan kept verbatim in the test
tracks: four irregular closed tracks with a hairpin and random arc surplus
projection_equivalence.positions_per_track: 4000 each on-centerline, near and far random; every sample exactly and one ulp off; extreme magnitudes 1e6, 1e150, 1e200, 1e300; square centre tie

byte_identical_reruns.note: Made with the final source above. An earlier identical comparison, out/runs/phase0-projection-*, was made before tire.cpp and the validation fast path. scenario-stop exits 2 like its original because it stops without completing a lap.

tire_model.mutation_check: replacing S = tan(pi/(2Q)) with fastest-lap's S = pi/(2*atan(Q)) failed 5 of the then 9 groups

plan_correction.item: TrackWayFastPlan Phase 2.1 wheel stiffness estimate used mu*Fz/kappa_max; the tire's small-slip slope is 2.705 times that
plan_correction.consequence: wheel time constant about 1.1 ms at 20 m/s (plan: 3 ms); explicit 1 ms step unstable below about 8.8 m/s (plan: about 7 m/s); implicit wheel integration remains required
